description.zh: 经典中国象棋。支持双人对弈与人机对战（简单/中等/困难三档 AI），完整象棋规则——将军、将死、困毙、蹩马腿、塞象眼、炮打隔子、将帅对脸，附带悔棋、棋谱与胜负统计。
description.en: Classic Xiangqi with two-player mode and VS Computer (Easy/Medium/Hard AI). Full rule support - check, checkmate, stalemate, horse-leg blocking, elephant-eye blocking, cannon screen captures and the facing-generals rule. Includes undo, move record and win stats.

controls.zh: 鼠标点击选子，再点击目标位置落子
controls.en: Click a piece, then click the destination
